_comment: Each row needs gameKey and the current source hash; each group needs why.
Matching hashes remove the row from this language pack's translation inventory.
A changed source hash fails validation so the exclusion is reviewed. Translated rows are still served.

exclusion_groups.why: Keep general combat action names in English. Spanish translates actions only for explicitly selected systems.
Keep general combat action descriptions in English. Spanish translates actions only for explicitly selected systems.
Keep general battle NPC names in English. Spanish translates enemy names only for explicitly selected systems.
Keep class and job names in English. Beastmaster remains the only translated job.
Keep general pet names in English. Spanish translates pets only for explicitly selected systems.
Keep general status names and descriptions in English. Spanish translates statuses only for explicitly selected systems.
Keep general trait names in English. Spanish translates traits only for explicitly selected systems.
Keep general trait descriptions in English. Spanish translates traits only for explicitly selected systems.
Keep item names and descriptions in English, except for individual translations chosen by the Spanish project.
Keep other quest key item names in English. Spanish translates explicitly selected quest items.
Keep descriptions of unselected quest key items in English.
